note: Font Awesome supplies field plugins for core 'string' fields (no new field type). Widgets: font_awesome_icon_picker_widget (current) and font_awesome_icon_picker (legacy, default 'fas fa-eye'). Formatter: font_awesome_icon (extends StringFormatter) with settings size (fa-xs..fa-10x) and fixed_width (default fa-fw). Requires lp_fontawesome for the actual assets. Config is per field on Manage form display / Manage display. Medium introspection reads back the size setting of a known icon formatter; hard execution has the agent set a string field's display formatter to font_awesome_icon with size fa-3x, verified on the live view display. Fixtures create their own namespaced string field (field_fa_*) and delete only that field.

evals.prompt: Does the font_awesome (Font Awesome fields) module define its own field type for storing icons? What kind of field do you use, and what does it store?
evals.expected_output: No new field type is defined. You use a core plain-text (string) field; it stores an icon class string like 'fas fa-eye'. The module only adds widgets and a formatter for string fields.

evals.prompt: Which field formatter does font_awesome provide to render an icon, and what two display settings does it expose?
evals.expected_output: The formatter is font_awesome_icon ('Icon'), for string fields. Its settings are size (empty, or fa-xs..fa-10x) and fixed_width (fa-fw by default). It renders the value as <i class="value size fixed_width">.

evals.prompt: Where do the actual Font Awesome assets (the JS/SVG font) come from when using the font_awesome module, since the module doesn't bundle the font?
evals.expected_output: From the required lp_fontawesome module (built on Libraries Provider), which handles CDN vs local, minification and version. The formatter attaches lp_fontawesome/fontawesome when an icon renders.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has a text field (field_fa_known) whose display uses the Font Awesome Icon formatter with a specific size class. Inspect the live default view display for Article and report the icon size setting.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_fa_known component uses formatter font_awesome_icon with settings.size = fa-2x.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a plain text field field_fa_task. Using the font_awesome module, configure the default display so this field renders as a Font Awesome icon at size 'fa-3x' (three times). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_fa_task component has type = font_awesome_icon and settings.size = fa-3x (e.g. $vd->setComponent('field_fa_task', ['type'=>'font_awesome_icon','settings'=>['size'=>'fa-3x','fixed_width'=>'fa-fw']])->save()).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a text field (field_fa_wknown) whose edit form uses a Font Awesome icon-picker widget. Inspect the live default form display for Article and report the machine name of the widget that field uses.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_fa_wknown component uses widget type font_awesome_icon_picker_widget (Font Awesome icon picker).

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a plain text field field_fa_wtask. Using the font_awesome module, configure the default edit form so editors pick its value with the Font Awesome icon picker widget (font_awesome_icon_picker_widget). Apply the change to the live site.
